appDesc.message: CookieCloud is a tool for syncing browser cookies to a self-hosted server.
appDesc.description: Uses end-to-end encryption to ensure your cookies are secure.

fullMessagePlease.message: Please fill in all the information

actionNotAllowedInPause.message: This action cannot be performed while paused

failedCheckInfo.message: Failed, please check if the information entered is correct

overwriteModeDesp.message: Overwrite mode is mainly used for cloud and read-only browsers. Overwriting Cookies and Local Storage may cause current browser login and modification operations to fail; moreover, some websites do not allow the same cookie to be logged in on multiple browsers at the same time, which may cause account logouts on other browsers.

syncPasswordPlaceholder.message: Data will be unable to be decrypted if lost

cookieExpireMinutesPlaceholder.message: 0 means it expires immediately after closing the browser

requestHeaderPlaceholder.message: Append Header to request for server authentication etc., one per line, format as 'Key:Value', no spaces allowed

syncDomainKeywordPlaceholder.message: One per line, sync all domains containing the keyword, e.g., qq.com, jd.com will include all subdomains, leave blank to sync all by default

syncDomainBlacklistPlaceholder.message: The blacklist only takes effect when the sync domain keyword is empty. One domain per line, matching domains will not be synced

cookieKeepLivePlaceholder.message: Periodically refresh URL in the background to simulate user activity. One URL per line, default 60 minutes, can specify refresh time with URL|minutes format

cryptoLegacyDesc.message: Uses CryptoJS encryption algorithm with dynamic IV generation

cryptoAesCbcFixedDesc.message: Uses standard AES-128-CBC algorithm with fixed IV (0x0)

pageSubtitle.message: Manage sync settings and review cookies and sync status

settingsIntro.message: Configure sync behavior, encryption, and sync scope.

importFailed.message: Import failed, please check the JSON file

managerHintEdit.message: Try not to change name, domain, or path while editing, or a new cookie may be written.

managerHintExpire.message: expirationDate uses a seconds timestamp; leave it blank to keep the current expiry.

managerHintBlacklist.message: Adding to the blacklist only changes sync scope and does not delete local cookies.

managerIntro.message: Browse cookies by domain, then search, edit, delete, or blacklist domains.

managerIntroCompact.message: Browse cookies by domain with filters, batch actions, and editing.

searchDomainPlaceholder.message: Enter a domain keyword, such as github or qq.com

blacklistEffectiveHint.message: No sync domain keywords are configured, so the blacklist will affect the actual sync scope.

blacklistInactiveHint.message: Sync domain keywords are configured, so the blacklist is shown only as a marker and does not affect the actual sync scope.

blacklistInactiveDomainHint.message: Sync domain keywords are configured, so this marker does not currently prevent the domain from being synced.

selectionRetainedHint.message: Selections in other filtered results are preserved

selectDomainsFirst.message: Select at least one domain first

diffPreviewIntro.message: Review local and remote differences within the current sync scope.

noDiffData.message: No diff data yet. Refresh to load it.

syncLogsIntro.message: Review recent sync records and results.
